episodes.content:
## Classification
Standalone planned episode. Format: Troll. Engagement: share. Audience: vibe coders, developers and startup founders. Delivery: confident and completely straight-faced.
## Selected concept
Spend \$857 in tokens building an app that cancels subscriptions, then proudly brag that it saved \$6.
## Text hook
> I spent \$857 in tokens to build an app that cancels my subscriptions
## Draft spoken beats
> It already saved me six dollars. Found a subscription I wasn’t even using. Canceled it automatically.
Brief pause and confident nod.
## Possible ending
> This is what people don’t understand about building your own tools.
## Performance
The confidence is the joke. Do not calculate the payback period, acknowledge the loss or explain the contradiction. Make the small saving sound like a clear win.
## Share appeal
The friend who builds an expensive tool to solve a tiny financial problem.
## Production notes
Selected premise and draft beats, not a finished script. Dollar amounts are part of the comedy premise, not verified spending. No publish date or challenge day assigned.

episodes.content:
## Classification
Standalone planned episode. Format: Troll. Engagement: share. Audience: vibe coders, developers and startup founders. Delivery: confident and completely straight-faced.
## Selected concept
Celebrate growing usage as a business success while your own card pays for everyone’s AI calls. The flawed reasoning is that the business model works because someone is paying—even though it is you.
## Draft opening
> My startup finally processed its first payment. Unfortunately, it was my card paying for everyone else’s AI.
## Development
Proudly show sign-ups or usage as if they were revenue. Treat covering customers’ costs as frictionless product design.
## Possible ending
> We’ve completely removed payment friction. From the customer side.
## Share appeal
The builder or founder who celebrates sign-ups before working out the cost per user.
## Production notes
Fictional comedy concept; draft opening and ending only. No completed script, publish date or challenge day assigned.

episodes.content:
## Classification
Standalone planned episode. Format: Troll. Engagement: share. Audience: vibe coders, developers and startup founders. Delivery: confident and completely straight-faced.
## Selected concept — revised
Build an AI agent to prevent wasteful AI spending. It runs continually in the background, consuming tokens and increasing the bill without telling you about that spend. You interpret its silence as reassurance.
## Draft text hook
> I built an AI agent to stop me wasting money on AI.
## Draft spoken direction
Explain confidently that it constantly checks for unnecessary spending.
> It hasn’t flagged anything yet, which is reassuring. The bill’s gone up quite a bit, but that’s the monitoring.
## Important user correction
The joke is silent spending and misplaced confidence. Do not revert to the previous concept where every check detects rising costs and sends another warning.
## Share appeal
The friend who introduces another AI agent to solve their AI spending problem.
## Production notes
Selected premise with draft lines, not a finished script. The situation is a comedy premise, not a claim about an actual monitoring product. No publish date or challenge day assigned.
